text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, gasp*...!!
Gh, aaah――!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't... reach it...!!
After all that... after considering and building up so much, over and over—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how much I ran, ran, and ran!
No matter how hard I chased... I couldn't reach them...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOO!!
Way to go, Cesarioooo!!
You truly deserve to be queen!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yet my journey starts here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Not yet—it starts from here.
To become a worthy vessel as one who weaves the era.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall devote myself diligently.
...Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Before I knew it... I was standing frozen in shock.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(In silence, just... her gaze.
I was completely captivated by its sharpness.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I can't help but realize it.
Those eyes of Cesario's. That's—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Those were the eyes of someone undergoing an evolution.)
And some time after the Yushun Himba (Oaks)...

At a press conference suddenly held for Cesario,
a shocking announcement was made.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Wh...?! C-Cesario is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: To the American Oaks...！？

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, an invitation from America...!
So you're heading there to become the 'Queen' of that country as well, are you!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I plan to make preparations immediately
and travel to America.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“And without fail—
I will grasp the first glory for a Japanese Umamusume in these hands.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So that I too may serve as a cornerstone, joining the long, unbroken history of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I swear right here and now
that I will show you a performance overwhelmingly more evolved
than the one at the Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooohh...!!

I turn off the TV as the press conference ends.
Instantly, a painful silence settles over the room...
as if recounting the tremendous energy of the conference just moments ago.

Cesario's words carried immense strength.
They were filled with absolute conviction.
And that was precisely why—a sudden chill ran down my spine.
choice_data_list: (How much will she grow... by autumn...?!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the final leg of the Triple Tiara...
The Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as I told you at the beginning...
this is a race that I simply cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Especially the Shuka Sho.
That race where Mother was the G1 favorite for the first time
in her career... and suffered defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As their daughter, I will win.
And I will prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To prove that Mother was never just 'close'!
To show the sacred strength of the bloodline passed down to me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With these legs of mine—without fail!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I cannot drop this race. ...I refuse to lose.
No matter what, the Shuka Sho is one I must—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That's why... the data—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us revise Cesario-san's data.
Her projected growth results... must be estimated significantly higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And then... please let me restructure our plans.
Regarding our upcoming training, including the summer training camp menu."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Based on the data... we should reconsider.
The usual policy. The usual approach. Air Messiah's proposal itself was no different from ordinary.

However, her voice was unmistakable—
it was remarkably faint.

Course correction. Re-examination. Re-examination.
...That day's meeting ended up taking
an unimaginably long time.
